title: Moxi execution debugger — I13
scenario: Replay the existing I15 captured episode through actual Moxi subtrees; inspect correlated work and frames, compare policies, and recover from missing or invalid data.
host: macOS arm64; local T3 Chromium preview
backend: Mojo 1.1.0 (8189361e); TypedSubtreeExecutor → ColumnRuntime → Scene → SvgSceneRenderer; Python loopback HTTP host
fixture: Existing synthetic I15 v1 episode.json and missing.json, preserved unchanged
reproduce:
From the repository root: pixi run execution-debugger
For a custom port, in the repository pixi environment:
python3 examples/execution-debugger/app.py --port 18173
Open http://127.0.0.1:18173/ at 1280 × 1000 CSS pixels, DPR 2.
In the normal page console: const {run} = await import('/ui-tests.js');
For a full behavioral run on a fresh page: await (await import('/ui-tests.js')).runAll()
For captures, reload first and follow each slide's ordered action, awaiting run(name).
The compare-detail image was captured separately with the same complete fixture,
capacity 16, selected action 13 and broad comparison; its scroll is recorded.
For the narrow capture, reload and reopen the on-disk I15 fixture at 390 × 844.
Use real browser screenshots, preserve them unmodified, and update their hashes,
timestamps and dimensions before rebuilding the deck with the README command.
Single-run timing values vary; exact screenshot bytes are not deterministic.

slides.caption: Normal entry point before opening an episode
slides.action: Freshly navigate to /. await run('initial'); capture at scroll 0.
slides.expected: Empty viewer and disabled comparison controls; no fabricated actions.

slides.caption: First source observation rebuilds only the reading subtree
slides.action: await run('open') on the fresh page; capture at scroll 0.
slides.expected: Action 1 is tick 12 (120 ms), value 25; selected build deltas [1, 0]; real Moxi SVG.

slides.caption: Stored async result correlated with its real frame and subtree work
slides.action: await run('reopen'), await run('inspect'), then await run('compare'); capture at scroll 0.
slides.expected: Action 13 applies peak 84 at unknown source time; build deltas [0, 1]; comparison final state and selected frame match.

slides.caption: Identical frames with different measured rebuild work
slides.action: At capacity 16 select the last action and await run('compare'); scrollTo(0, 300), which clamps to 247.5 CSS px; capture.
slides.expected: Both actual Moxi frames show reading 32 / peak 84; totals [13, 2] vs [14, 14], selected deltas [0, 1] vs [1, 1].

slides.caption: Trace eviction stays distinct from source eviction
slides.action: Return to scroll 0. await run('repeat'), then await run('dropped'); capture.
slides.expected: Capacity 5 retains action ordinals 9–13, reports 8 trace drops of 13 and separately reports 12 source evictions.

slides.caption: Incomplete I15 episode remains inspectable
slides.action: await run('missing'); capture at scroll 0 after selecting the last retained sample.
slides.expected: Missing retained tick 13 and absent async result are explicit; peak remains Unavailable, with no invented result action.

slides.caption: Malformed reopen preserves the last valid frame
slides.action: await run('malformed'); capture the error and last good incomplete-episode frame.
slides.expected: Visible JSON parse error; the prior frame remains unchanged.

slides.caption: Opening the complete episode clears the error
slides.expected: Complete captured episode restored; error clears; source and trace loss remain explicit at capacity 5.

slides.caption: Reload and file reopen at a narrow viewport
slides.action: Reload /. Resize to 390 × 844 CSS px. Upload examples/flight-recorder/evidence/episode.json through the actual file input. Wait for replay; select the last action. await run('layout'); scroll the selection heading into view; capture at scrollY 935.
slides.expected: 13 actions reopen from the saved file; stored peak 84 appears; document scroll width is 390 and the counters table scrolls inside its own container.
